notes: Posts: a number is the signal of that number in the OEC yard. Calling-on (C1, C3) and shunt aspects (SH1A-F, SH3, SH28A/B, SH30A/B, SH42..SH52) share the post of the main or starter signal. Signals that belong to the neighbouring cabins are written with an @ suffix: @F = 'F' CABIN (2, 6, 31), @E = 'E' CABIN (18), @VPT = VPT R&D YARD (15), @DUMPER = dumper cabin (1, 2, 4). The chart text 'S6 OF F CABIN' maps to post 6@F.
Point 105 (N0085): the straight leg towards 'F' CABIN is the trap (T17), so 105 normal is the trap and 105 reverse opens the ELS ENGINE LINE (T03) into LINE No.- 11. SH5B needs 105R, SH5A needs 105N.

Point 156 (N0036) is the derailing switch at the end of the STABLING LINE: normal is the stub (T06), reverse joins the connecting line (T09). Point 116 (N0044): normal LINE No.- 17, reverse LINE No.- 18.

Crossover circuits come from the chart: 111A/B in 111AXT+111BXT, 103A/B in 103/105XT+103BXT, 126A/B in 126AXT+126BXT, 108A/B in 108AXT+108BXT, 135A/B in 135AXT+135BXT. The chart has no circuit of its own for 106A/B (routes over 106R list only 108BXT) or for 115A/B (1A over 115R ends in 19AXT).
No block section is configured: the OEC chart has no TGT/LC remarks. The BULB LINE to 'E' CABIN is a block section (SIP note 9) and may need one once the instrument names are known.
Hand points HP (DLS yard and shunting neck, control 0) are not in the chart; they stay normal.
